tickets.name: Set Play
tickets.note: It's Bucks and Knicks, and buddy, we've got a plan for the opening act! Towns and Turner meet in the circle, and Towns has been winning these jumps all season long! That puts the Knicks on the front foot to get on the board first. If the Bucks steal the tip or get the first stop, Turner is who we want firing first! Burries is right behind him, ready to pounce on any mistake! Whoever lights it up first, the split covers the game. Let's ride!

tickets.name: Top of the Key
tickets.note: Celtics at 76ers, and the race to the first bucket starts at center court! It starts with Embiid against Queta at center court, and our money says Embiid gets up there first! Either side can strike first here, and we like the Celtics to make it count! If Queta controls the tip, he taps it to a guard, rolls to the rim, and boom, he's the first look! And Walsh is the second option on that same trip, and the price is a beauty! Any of them scores first, and we're counting money!
